page.overview:
Who is Boddle's Assistant?

Boddle's Assistant is a supporting character in Mario & Luigi: Superstar Saga and its Nintendo 3DS remake Mario & Luigi: Superstar Saga + Bowser's Minions.

Boddle's Assistant is a Beanish character with bucked teeth. In the Game Boy version of the game, he has yellow hair and wears a blue shirt. In the 3DS remake, the assistant has his palette changed to have a purple shirt and brown hair and shoes; this is incidentally an unused palette for him in the original Game Boy version.

Boddle's Assistant seems to be pessimistic by the way he spoke to the Bros., believing that they are going to mess up with Boddle. However, Boddle ignored him and aimed to hit him for his impudence. Although he did this action, he seems very loyal to Boddle. He even had no belief that Mario and Luigi will have the ability to get all the Neon Eggs, meaning he is thinking they'll never get them.
